notes: Product review batch 2 (v1.11.31): five P1 ideas (P1-6–P1-10). P1-6: useful recording at timer stop — when a timer stops with no useful recorded for that session, the box card asks how useful it was, with 100% / 75% / 50% chips plus a minutes field; skipping leaves the session «ثبت نشده» (never 0, never fabricated), and useful still never exceeds real time. P1-7: single backlog centre — the «گذشته» tab is now the only place for undone past work (suggestions + undone + done + hidden items, restorable here); the Analytics «بررسی گذشته» section only links to it instead of duplicating the list. P1-8: the day-summary label is fixed (it printed the raw "{d} از {t}" template) and the Analytics default range is now the current week (Saturday to today), with a «کل برنامه» chip for the whole programme. P1-9: the Exams tab opens the nearest upcoming exam instead of the first item in the list (when a category has no upcoming exam, the last held one). P1-10: box edits go through POST /api/boxes/* (the server is the single validation reference) and GET /api/boxes is the source the app loads its boxes from; if the server cannot answer, the app falls back to the local edit and the data.json seed exactly as before, so nothing is ever lost. The dashboard delete path is untouched (delete → state.deleted → auto-push, with the 1.11.27 delete-retry fix). Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix, the 1.11.30 tick dates and Dey builder are untouched.
